capabilities: Complete typed pinyin tokens into Chinese characters in place
Load local Rime .dict.yaml dictionaries, including import_tables
Fall back to the longest valid pinyin prefix when no full match exists
Configure candidate selection shortcuts, paging, and double-space acceptance
Disable completion inside code blocks, inline code, and math contexts
extras: Desktop-only because dictionaries are read from the local filesystem; a local Rime dictionary file is required (set via the dictionary path setting). Dictionary index is in-memory and rebuilt on demand; no adaptive candidate learning yet.
intentEvidence: It allows users to keep typing English letters in the editor while treating the current token as pinyin in the background.
problem: Typing Chinese in Obsidian requires frequently switching between English and Chinese input methods, which interrupts the typing flow.

relations.evidence: Reads local Rime .dict.yaml dictionaries, including import_tables.

summary: Pinyin completion plugin that converts typed English-letter tokens into Chinese text in place, using local Rime dictionaries.
